lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x30x30 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 27.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 30x30x30 cm terrarium (27 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

A length of 30 cm and a width of 30 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. On this floor area you can easily set up a basking spot and a cool side, the basis of proper reptile care. The ventilation system is designed for constant airflow that prevents overheating and trapped moisture.

When ordering, you choose the decorative film, the 3D background style and the ventilation type. Non-standard dimensions, LED lighting and a thermostat are available as options. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for full details. Delivery across Serbia.
